newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile supermarket group D&S plans major expansion.
newsitem.headline: Chile supermarket group D&S plans major expansion.

text.p: Chilean supermarket group D&S said it will invest $400 million in the next three years in expanding its network of stores in Chile and Argentina.
"This will allow us to increase the number of outlets in Chile from 37 at present to more than 50," D&S general manager Nicolas Ibanez told a news conference.
D&S, which is about to start trading on the Santiago bourse, owns the Almac, Ekono and Lider supermarket chains.
In Argentina, the plan includes investing $150 million in building six new stores in Buenos Aires, bringing the total number of outlets in the city to nine, he said.
The company will study building hypermarkets in the Argentine provinces and may move into other countries in Latin America, he said.

"We are studying the possibility in the future of expanding to other countries, but for the moment we are concentrating on Chile and Argentina because of the good opportunities offered by these markets," said Ibanez.
D&S will sell $50 million shares on the stock market this month -- the shares will be issued as part of a $90 million capital increase.
The proceeds from the IPO will be used to fund the expansion plan, with the rest of the financing coming from the company's own resources, said Ibanez.
D&S may in the future also raise funds in international markets through the American Depositary Receipt (ADRs) mechanism and bond issues as well as fresh share sales in the local market, he said.
Ibanez said the group expects sales to rise to $750 million this year, up 35 percent on 1995.
D&S is the second Chilean supermarket group to announce large expansion plans in the last two weeks.
Unimarc, part of the Errazuriz group, said last month it was planning a $122 million capital increase with shares to be sold directly to a foreign strategic investor or issued on Wall Street as ADRs.
Chile's largest supermarket chain, Santa Isabel, started trading in New York last year.
